checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: audit range 1->18 layer visibility, locks and camera bookmarks; prune selection when a layer is hidden

impact_assessment.why: Range 1->18 added layer visibility. Hiding a layer removes its nodes from the viewport but leaves them selected, so inspector edits and gizmos still act on invisible nodes.
impact_assessment.benefits: Selection and hidden-layer state stay coherent, and stale hidden selections disappear from every editor document.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: selection state only; dependency: existing layer inventory; concurrency: session lock unchanged; state: selected_ids/selected_id.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Filter selected ids against hidden node layers when hiding, add a hide/show selection regression, and run the 6/6 gate.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Prune hidden-layer nodes from the selection on set_layer_visible; regression covers mixed-layer selection and no restore on show
[3/3] Range 1->18 gate passes 6/6 with coherent hidden-layer selection; checklists: passed

handoff.next: commit and push range 1->18, then continue at 1->21

[1/3] Plan: audit range 1->21 reload identity; rebind registry material payloads when their texture reloads

impact_assessment.why: Range 1->21 rebinds scene, history, prefab and clipboard payloads after reload, but registry material records keep old inline texture objects, so future material assignments can render stale data.
impact_assessment.benefits: Texture hot reload reaches every material owner, and the report exposes registry material rebinds.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: additive asset_reload field; dependency: Material replacement helper; concurrency: session lock unchanged; state: registry records and payload identities.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Rebind material records before scene payloads, add old-to-new material mappings, add a texture-file regression, and run the 6/6 gate.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Rebind registry material payloads to reloaded textures before scene rebinding; regression checks registry, node and texture identities
[3/3] Range 1->21 gate passes 6/6 with registry material rebinding; checklists: passed

handoff.next: commit and push range 1->21, then continue at 1->24

[1/3] Plan: audit range 1->24 refresh ordering and state-machine/startup fixes; order prefab sources after non-prefab sources

impact_assessment.why: Dependency-first refresh uses the old graph. A changed prefab that starts referencing a changed mesh not in its old dependency list can load before that mesh and keep the old payload.
impact_assessment.benefits: New prefab-to-asset edges are resolved against the freshly loaded non-prefab records without a second pass.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: refresh order only; dependency: AssetRecord.kind; concurrency: synchronous refresh unchanged; state: registry records and source marks.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Prioritize non-prefab ready sources, add a new-dependency prefab regression, and run the 6/6 gate.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Order prefab sources after non-prefab sources during refresh; regression covers a prefab that newly references a changed mesh
[3/3] Range 1->24 gate passes 6/6 with new prefab asset edges resolved first; checklists: passed

handoff.next: commit and push range 1->24, then continue at 1->27

checkpoints.description: Task 'keystone-commit-audit-v3-1to24' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: audit range 1->27 lock inheritance and crossfade fixes; block child additions under locked parents

impact_assessment.why: Locked nodes reject direct edits, but create_node, paste, reparent and insert_prefab resolve a locked parent without an unlock check, so they mutate a locked node's child list.
impact_assessment.benefits: Lock protection now covers hierarchy growth, matching the documented locked-node contract.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: parent resolution for four actions; dependency: existing ancestor-aware lock helper; concurrency: session lock unchanged; state: scene hierarchy.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Enforce unlock in _parent_locked, add create/insert/reparent rejection tests, and run the 6/6 gate.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Reject delete_node/delete_selection when any affected descendant is locked; regression covers unlocked parent with locked child

handoff.state: subtree delete protection and regression green

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Range 1->27 gate passes 6/6 with locked-descendant deletion protection; checklists: passed

[1/3] Plan: audit range 1->30 prefab override apply; make baseline rebase transactional with the library write

impact_assessment.why: apply_prefab_override updates instance baselines before the prefab library write. A failed write loses the override report even though the template was never updated.
impact_assessment.benefits: Failed override applies leave the editor report and baselines unchanged.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: apply_prefab_override failure path; dependency: prefab baselines; concurrency: session lock unchanged; state: baselines and prefab cache.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Snapshot baselines before the action, restore on failure, add a patched-write regression, and run the 6/6 gate.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Snapshot and restore instance baselines when apply_prefab_override or its library write fails; regression covers a patched write

handoff.state: transactional override apply and regression green
